### [How we built our multi-agent research system](<https://www.anthropic.com/engineering/multi-agent-research-system>)

Anthropic describes an orchestrator-worker research system in which a lead agent delegates independent searches and synthesizes compact findings from separate subagent contexts. The report offers concrete practices for task boundaries, effort allocation, tool design, evaluation, and recovery when building parallel research agents.

**Evidence:** engineering-report; full-text. The June 13, 2025 article explains the architecture and observed coordination failures, backed by internal research evaluations and production experience. Its reported 90.2% improvement concerns an Opus 4/Sonnet 4 multi-agent configuration against single-agent Opus 4 on an internal research evaluation.

**Limitations:** Internal evaluation data do not establish a public leaderboard result or isolate coordination from additional compute. The article reports much higher token use and cautions that tightly coupled work is less suited to parallel agents.
